stem:
Read these sentences from paragraph 4.

"One former publisher told me recently that Barry Bingham, Jr., "was the visionary among us. He said what we didn’t want to hear and we ran from it.""

The primary purpose of the text above is to —

options.label: F
options.text: indicate the competitive nature of the newspaper business

options.label: G
options.text: describe how surprised the author’s father was at how things turned out

options.label: H
options.text: explain Barry Bingham, Jr.’s success in the newspaper business

options.label: J
options.text: support the idea that Barry Bingham, Jr.’s predictions were accurate

visual_elements: One former publisher told me recently that Barry Bingham, Jr., “was the visionary among us. He said what we didn’t want to hear and we ran from it.”
